toolDefinitions.name: list_pricing_data
toolDefinitions.description: Discover local product IDs/names and available channel rule IDs with provenance. Choose only a matching record; clarify ambiguity.

toolDefinitions.name: get_product
toolDefinitions.description: Read product costs (BRL, grams, hours, kW) and provenance. Null is unknown.

toolDefinitions.name: get_channel_rule
toolDefinitions.description: Read separate revenue charge rates, fixed fee, source and validity. No Shopee rules exist.

toolDefinitions.name: calculate_scenarios
toolDefinitions.description: Deterministic C# costs and prices. Margins and discount are fractions. Uses stored product/rule, never model-invented costs. Includes undiscounted and discounted scenarios.

toolDefinitions.name: submit_recommendation
toolDefinitions.description: Submit a draft referring only to successful scenario IDs. No prices are applied. Human approval is required.

toolDefinitions.name: request_clarification
toolDefinitions.description: Stop and ask specific questions when essential data/rules/objectives are missing.

data.summary: Synthetic demo comparison for headset-stand on 2026-10-24 using demo-direct rule. Compared revenue margins of 20%, 30%, and 40% with 10% discount. Undiscounted recommended prices: BRL 38.10, 44.45, and 53.34. Discounted charged prices: BRL 34.29, 40.01, and 48.01. Discount lowers realized revenue margin below target in all discounted cases.
assumptions: Product and rule are synthetic demonstration fixtures, not confirmed business data.
Revenue charges are based on the same sales price; rule uses 10% channel fee, 0% tax, 0% advertising, and BRL 2 fixed fee.
Failure provision is included from the stored 10% failure rate with full-print retry assumption.
All results are from deterministic tool output as-of 2026-10-24.
limitations: Full-print retry assumption may overstate failure cost if rework/recovery differs.
No marketplace verification was performed; rule is synthetic, not a current Shopee fee schedule.
Discounted prices do not retain the requested revenue margin in any scenario; realized margins are ~12.23%, ~23.35%, and ~34.46% for the 20%, 30%, and 40% targets respectively.
